evalStudio.datasetsEmptyHint: Import a dataset (CSV / JSON / JSONL / OpenAI-Evals) via POST /api/eval/dataset/import.

generate.augmentHint: Paraphrase an existing dataset's rows into fresh phrasings that keep the same expectations.
generate.fromAgentHint: Ground the model on the agent's system prompt, slots and flow goals to synthesize candidate cases.
generate.noLlm: The model returned no rows — attach an enabled LLM to the agent (or set a default) and retry.
generate.reviewEmptyHint: Generate or augment above — candidates land here as an editable draft. Nothing is saved until you review and save.

history.emptyHint: Run the gate to establish a baseline — every run is kept here with its per-case breakdown and plotted on the score timeline.
history.runError: Could not run the gate — the agent may have no enabled set or usable LLM.
history.selectHint: Select a run to see its per-case breakdown.

nlFacet.compareHint: Runs the pack through every copilot planning strategy — expensive: an LLM-assisted row costs up to three LLM calls per case.
nlFacet.emptyHint: Import a pack above to save it as a reusable dataset.
nlFacet.importTitle: Import a pack as a dataset
nlFacet.intro: Semantic Navigation NL→facet packs, folded onto the shared eval-dataset model. Import a pack once, then run it through the grounded parser scorer — one Studio, one gate.
nlFacet.noLlm: No usable default LLM is configured — the NL→facet parser needs one to run.

online.emptyHint: Enable online eval on the agent and run now (or wait for the nightly sweep) to sample live traffic. The first snapshot becomes the healthy baseline; later windows are checked for drift against it.

review.auditHint: Decide whether this MODEL verdict was correct to calibrate the judge.
review.awaitingMore: Verdict recorded — awaiting more reviewers before consensus.
review.emptyHint: Tasks appear here when an agent's human-review grader defers a case — or when you sample a MODEL-graded run for a calibration audit above.
review.selectHint: Select a task to review its transcript.
review.submitted: Verdict submitted and merged into the latest report.

evalStudio.stacksEmptyHint: Create a reusable grader stack via POST /api/eval/grader-stack and bind it to an eval set.
evalStudio.subtitle: Reusable datasets and grader stacks for the evaluation platform — provide a dataset, compose a grader stack, and share them across agents.
evalStudio.title: Eval Studio
